recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No FHIR-core follow-up is needed for FHIR-5624 unless OO wants new editorial examples beyond the existing four UDI examples, which would be new work rather than reconciliation of this published tracker.
issue_request: FHIR-5624 was a Published/Persuasive OO change request for FHIR-core Device asking to create UDI examples, possibly covering both UDI as an instance identifier and UDI as a type identifier.
initial_application: No local git commit explicitly mentions FHIR-5624. The same Device UDI example work appears to have been applied through later Device/UDI history: 966df8c99a9ec454013169646fe4862b168b0b03 rewrote Device to incorporate UDI and added the first UDI example, and 7822ee3e2fa15a9b65749057bf285f263bc475a0, tagged for FHIR-9111, added more UDI examples.
additional_context: FHIR-9111 was a later Published/Persuasive Device request to fix and add more UDI examples using JIC examples. A 2016 Zulip Device/UDI thread records Eric Haas saying he was addressing Device trackers by creating more examples, rewriting text, and adding mappings to UDI components. Device is active in source/fhir.ini, and source/device/list-Device-examples.xml includes Device/example-udi1 through Device/example-udi4.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current Device examples include four UDI example resources with udiCarrier.deviceIdentifier values, carrierHRF and entryType examples, serial/lot production data, and multiple issuer formats; Device.udiCarrier text also explicitly says a UDI may identify a unique instance, a device type, or production information.

related_jiras.note: Later Published/Persuasive Device issue and git-tagged application path that added and corrected the UDI examples now satisfying FHIR-5624.
